name: Imuth Maer Doquin
title: Imuth Maer Doquin
summary: A line of ancient Empyrean buildings on a gentle wooded slope: a 19 m Empyrean stone tower with an open plank top, two stone bunkers with golden plates, a giant tree and an octagon spire hall at the east end.

landmarks.name: Stone bunkers
landmarks.note: Two 0x0100110A bunkers (38388,21660) and (38316,21684) with golden plates.

site.name: Imuth Maer Doquin
site.notes: No gazetteer entry; teleport derived on open ground 30 m north of the bunkers (ground 40.0, nearest drawn object 14.4 m).

shots.standingOrder: Climb clockwise around the octagon spire hall of Imuth Maer Doquin from 36 m out and 15 m up to 46 m out and 32 m up; stay 15 m above the trees.
shots.notes: Helix on the octagon spire hall at the east end of the Empyrean ruins line (two stone bunkers, the hall, a stone tower and a giant tree); south-west sun lights the hall as the camera climbs above the tree tops. shots.standingOrder: Rise straight up 18 m south-west of the Empyrean stone tower from 3 m to 27 m, tilting down over its open top; keep 5 m from the trees at its foot.
